lgtm Recall Atlas

Every labelled (check, case) pair as one dot at the probability Jev gave it. Positives are cases labelled to fire, negatives labelled not to. The dashed line is the check's fitted threshold (worth a look); the solid line is 0.15 above it (high confidence). Recall is low wherever positives sit left of the dashed line; precision is lost wherever negatives sit right of it.

positivenegativelighter, smaller = synthetic

Curves on the right: precision (blue) and recall (orange) of the current selection if the threshold were set at each x. Hover a dot for the case. Public cases are named by their slug in evals/cases; private cases are numbered.
